attributes.action: Make the UK Great Britain 🇬🇧 again
attributes.additional_details: As the great British public pay for our government to protect us, they are failing us on a daily basis, you are putting the British public on severe danger, we don’t know who steps into a boat, but the government website states it’s illegal to enter so we put them in hotels and leave our ex servicemen that are homeless on our streets, they fought against what you’re letting in. We the public want a say  in what our money is being used for and to stop the boats
attributes.background: I talk for many genuine British citizens and we all pay into our system. The government was set up to help all of its genuine British citizens and we as a country definitely pay more than enough into our government. None of us asked for men of war fighting age to step into a dinghy and illegally

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
